pwp_core.howto.title: How to play
pwp_core.howto.card.lobby.title: Lobby
pwp_core.howto.card.lobby.body: Play takes you to the lobby. Vote for map, mode and sides — the lobby menu has its own key. The match starts by itself.
pwp_core.howto.card.staging.title: Staging
pwp_core.howto.card.staging.body: In the match you are put in a team and the main base. A timer at the top counts to the start; if everyone is ready it starts earlier.
pwp_core.howto.card.squad.title: Squad and role
pwp_core.howto.card.squad.body: In the squad menu join a squad (Quick join) and pick a role — the kit is issued at once. The leader takes Officer.
pwp_core.howto.card.deploy.title: Deploy
pwp_core.howto.card.deploy.body: After death: a point on the map (main, rally, FOB) → role → loadout → Respawn.
pwp_core.howto.card.points.title: Points and tickets
pwp_core.howto.card.points.body: Capture points in order. Deaths and lost vehicles cost tickets — the side that runs out loses.
pwp_core.howto.card.comms.title: Comms
pwp_core.howto.card.comms.body: Nearby voice is heard by everyone. Squad radio and the leaders channel have their own keys. Chat goes to your team by default.
pwp_core.ui_settings.hints.tip: Short hints with your real keys: menu, lobby, staging and combat. One-time hints do not repeat.
